svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Container delivery pipeline on AWS
svg.desc: Container delivery pipeline on AWS. 10 components in 3 groups. Connections: Developer to GitHub; GitHub to AWS CodeBuild (source); AWS CodeBuild to AWS CodeDeploy; AWS CodeDeploy to Approval gate; Approval gate to AWS CodeDeploy; AWS CodeBuild to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (push image); AWS CodeDeploy to Staging service (deploy); AWS CodeDeploy to Production service (deploy); Amazon CloudWatch to AWS CodeDeploy; Production service to Amazon CloudWatch (metrics).

text.tspan: AWS CodePipeline builds each push from GitHub, deploys it to staging, waits for approval and releases it to production on Amazon Elastic Container Service
